items.heading: Machboos Kuwaiti
details: Key ingredients: rice, chicken or shrimp, dried lime, baharat
Brown chicken or shrimp with onion and baharat spice blend.
Add dried lime and tomato paste, simmering into a fragrant sauce.
Cook rice in the spiced broth until fully absorbed.
Serve the rice topped with the meat and fried onions.

items.heading: Harees
details: Key ingredients: wheat, chicken or meat, ghee, cinnamon
Soak wheat and simmer it with chicken or meat for hours.
Beat the mixture continuously until the wheat and meat form a smooth porridge.
Stir in ghee for richness.
Serve warm, dusted with cinnamon.
